ns2:section.sectionText: Math 292 is restricted to students who currently have credit for "Math 24-" due to a transfer course. To get permission to register, email mathadvising@illinois.edu with your UIN and Name; we will verify the Math 24- credit. Section Z8 will be taught asynchronously. This section incorporates the use of technology through Mathematica assignments. See http://www.math.uiuc.edu/timetable/ for details.
